about: In Eastertide, this pair of Alleluia verses replaces the gradual and tract for Saint Joseph, Spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary.

seg.tr: Alleluia, alleluia. The Lord has loved him and has adorned him; He has clothed him in a robe of glory. Alleluia. The just man will bud like the lily, and will flourish for ever before the Lord. Alleluia.
